confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Nha Trang's tourist price levels; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by season, location, and booking channel. Cocktail and wine were estimated relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of local bar and wine prices is weaker. July is a busy dry-season month in Nha Trang, so accommodation anchors reflect that demand. The FX observation (0.6955 USD per AUD, 15 Oct 2026) was read from RBA homepage text in search results, not from the RBA daily table itself, so confirm it against the official table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional Vietnamese beach-resort pricing, compared with Da Nang and other mid-sized Vietnamese coastal tourist towns. Restaurant and drink prices follow typical tourist-area menus in Vietnam, and accommodation prices follow registered hostel and hotel rates in the central beach areas where visitors stay.
